title: Any change that reloads customer rows collapses all expansion, but typing in the Customer filter does not
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with at least one customer expanded down to invoice rows.
steps: 1. With rows expanded, open the Customer filter and TYPE a search query (do not change the selection); watch the expanded rows.
2. Now change the date range (or Product Type, location, Customer selection, or sort).
3. Look at the previously expanded rows.
expected: 1. Typing in the Customer filter's type-ahead only narrows the dropdown list — the expanded table rows stay expanded.
2. A change that re-fetches customer rows (date range, Product Type, location, Customer selection, or sort) collapses all expanded rows.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Reload clearing expansion (S8-R22) is covered by SBC-PERS-02.
